propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, causing ~26k subprocess launches per full suite run and projecting ~75s macOS wall-time overhead.

The ticket proposes replacing per-test Git subprocesses with in-process HEAD fingerprinting after one-time per-worker worktree metadata discovery, while preserving exact per-test checkout-move detection and test attribution.

Research consensus from four major OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) confirms that keeping source-checkout VCS subprocesses out of the per-test hot path is best practice, but no fidelity-preserving implementation primitive (Git library, hand-parsing refs, or removing attribution guard) met the automatic-approval bar.

The ticket was moved to blocked after plan-review survey, as neither adding a dependency library nor hand-parsing ref formats was consensus-backed and removing the guard would weaken checkout-attribution coverage.
Operator disposition on 2026-08-19 accepted the ticket as wontfix; the measured 75s projection remains unimplemented.
